name: Falling-sand pixel physics
doc: GPU Margolus falling-sand simulation of the input picture: pinned image pixels fracture into falling coloured sand grains on beats, bass hits and drops, piling up into dunes or catching on the picture's own edges, pushed laterally by the edge field, bouncing on bass quakes, and re-crystallizing back into the live video.

in.doc: source media image or video whose pixels crumble into sand

luma.doc: media brightness mask (e.g. core-media.luma) guiding crumble order and regrowth

edges.doc: media edge gradient (e.g. core-media.edges) acting as sand ledges and lateral wind

palette.doc: accent palette for fracture sparks, falling trails and dithered highlights

cells.doc: grid height in sand grains (width follows the screen aspect)

steps.doc: Margolus falling-sand physics substeps per frame

floor.doc: bottom behaviour: pile into dunes, drain like a pixel waterfall, or bounce up on bass

crumble.doc: how strongly drops, onsets and bass fracture pinned image chunks into falling sand

erosion.doc: steady ambient pixel erosion so the image always shimmers like an hourglass

resurface.doc: how fast empty cavities and settled grains re-crystallize into the live picture

edge_wall.doc: cohesion along media edges so contours catch falling sand like shelves

wind.doc: lateral drift from the media edge field and audio highs

fluidity.doc: horizontal avalanche spread of loose sand grains

quake.doc: upward bass-kick bounce that launches settled sand plumes into the air

pal_mix.doc: palette colour accent on fracture sparks and falling trails

dither.doc: 4x4 Bayer ordered dither styling on grains and void ghost

under.doc: dim dithered ghost of the picture visible inside crumbled voids

trail.doc: glowing streak trail left behind falling sand grains

flash.doc: onset fracture spark brightness and pixel RGB split

changelog.note: first version: GPU Margolus falling-sand pixel physics driven by media and audio drops
